in_marathi.long_meaning: Nanda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nanda is a Sanskrit name that means 'joy', 'bliss', or 'delight'. In Hindu mythology, Nanda is the name of Lord Krishna's foster father. Nanda is also the name of Lord Rama's mother.
